subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted authn log samples / bridge letter
messages:
From: Claire Sanderson <claire.sanderson@medipulse.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Medipulse Security <security@medipulse.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + targeted evidence request

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and security review we'd like to collect the following before we move to legal: the latest SOC 2 Type II report (if available), a signed bridge letter that covers the audit gap window if the Type II doesn't include the full 12-month period, and a small set of targeted control artifacts tied to authn controls. Specifically Medipulse needs: 

- MFA enforcement evidence for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30 (rotation/events summary + a small sample of successful/failed auth events)
- A 7-day slice (with timestamps) of authentication logs highlighting session creation, token issuance, and MFA challenge events for a scoped set of service accounts (we'll provide account IDs)
- Evidence of quarterly access review for privileged roles (sample review attestation + list of users remediated)

We are sensitive to PII so if you can provide redacted slices (IDs pseudonymized) that will work. Target timeline: can we get a plan for delivery by EOD Monday (2025-08-18)? If you need an NDA or additional paperwork let me know.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Sanderson
Sr. Security Program Manager | Medipulse Health
attachments: none
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Claire Sanderson <claire.sanderson@medipulse.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted evidence request

Hi Claire — thanks, and great to meet your team last week. We're happy to provide the materials and a proposed delivery plan. Quick clarifications before we scope the extracts: 

1) For the MFA enforcement evidence, do you want both admin-config screenshots (policy) and operational logs? We typically provide the policy export + a redacted log slice.
2) For the 7-day authn slice: please confirm the exact list of service account IDs you want included. We can also do a scoped extract by tag (e.g., bucketed by customer-alias) if that is easier.
3) For access review artifacts: do you want samples from one quarterly review or the last two quarters?

Proposed plan (high level): 
- Today: confirm scoping answers above and get any account IDs you want in the slice
- Thu 08/14: security will produce a sample spec (CSV) describing fields and pseudonymization approach + a draft bridge letter for your review
- Mon 08/18 EOD: deliver redacted 7-day authn slice, MFA policy export + summary of events, and privileged access review sample

I've looped in Laura (Security Compliance) and Markus (Security Engineering) to own the artifacts. If this timeline looks tight we can push to Wed 08/20.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted evidence request

Ava — draft of what security can deliver. See attached 'requested-control-matrix.xlsx' and 'authn-sample-spec.csv'. Short notes: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we have the 2024 Type II report covering 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. We will produce a bridge letter to cover Jan 1, 2025 through June 30, 2025. Draft bridge included (pdf) for legal review.
- MFA evidence: we'll provide the AuthN policy export + a summarized events CSV (counts by day + sample of redacted events). Rotation metadata will be included in the matrix.
- 7-day authn slice: as requested, redacted IDs (SHA256 pseudonyms) + timezone-normalized timestamps. The attached authn-sample-spec.csv lists fields we can include (timestamp, event_type, pseudonymized_user, service_account_tag, result, client_ip_partial).
- Access review: will provide one quarterly review package (Q2 2025) with reviewer attestation and the remediation list. If they require two quarters we can add Q1 but it pushes delivery by 48 hours.

Delivery plan: 08/18 EOD: deliverables zipped to a shared Drive folder + sign bridge letter. I'll coordinate S3 link + pre-signed download. Security will also redact any user_PII fields.

Attachments: requested-control-matrix.xlsx (control mapping), authn-sample-spec.csv, draft-bridge-letter-v1.pdf

-Markus
Markus Klein
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + targeted evidence request

Hi Ava / Markus — this looks good, thanks. A few quick confirmations: 

- Bridge letter scope is acceptable as written (covers 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30). Medipulse legal will want to stamp/sign; please send a fully-executed copy when ready.
- For the 7-day slice please include the following service account tags: medipulse-api, medipulse-ingest, medipulse-batch. No need to provide more than the single Q2 review for access recert.
- We're fine with pseudonymized IDs. Please redact full client IPs leaving first two octets.

If you can deliver the Drive link and the brief README for the extracts by end of day Monday that's perfect — we'll circulate to Sec Ops and Legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Claire
Sr. Security Program Manager | Medipulse Health
